author: MiniWarGaming
description:
Jim joins us today for an experiment in today's 2,000-point Battle Report. The Dark Angels will be attempting to push the Orkz out of their compound, something the Astra Militarum was unable to do.

We will merge the Core rules of 4th Edition Warhammer 40k with the mission formats of 10th Edition to see how well they blend.
